title: Eating well
description: Bài đọc về ăn uống lành mạnh.

vocabulary.meaning: Thiết yếu, vô cùng quan trọng
vocabulary.example: Eating well plays a vital role in good health and disease prevention.
Choosing natural foods is important for disease prevention.
Choosing food that is close to its natural form and not overly processed is best practice.

vocabulary.meaning: Sự tiết chế, mức độ vừa phải
vocabulary.example: Restaurant meals tend to have more salt and fat, so eat out in moderation.
Butter and processed meats are high in saturated fats.
Limit refined grains like white bread and white rice.
Doughnuts and pastries are high in sugar and low in nutrients.
Tomatoes are an excellent source of antioxidants.
Diets high in fiber promote digestive health.
High fiber foods can help lower cholesterol.
Eating breakfast improves focus and concentration in children.
Bananas help replenish carbohydrates and bodily fluids burned during exercise.

vocabulary.meaning: Giá cả hợp lý, vừa túi tiền
vocabulary.example: Some consider bananas the perfect food because they are affordable and nutritious.
Apples are low in calories and high in nutritional value.
The tomato is a close relative of the eggplant and red pepper.
Legumes are good plant-based sources of protein.
Choose whole grains instead of refined options like white pasta.
Broccoli and dark green leafy vegetables are excellent sources of fiber.

vocabulary.meaning: Có hiệu lực mạnh mẽ, công hiệu
vocabulary.example: Fresh vegetables contain potent compounds that help protect the body.
Proper hydration is essential when exercising for long periods.

mcqQuestions.q: What is the main purpose of the passage?
options: To convince readers to strictly follow a vegetarian diet.
To explain the economic benefits of buying organic food products.
To provide practical nutritional guidance on choosing healthier food choices.
To analyze the medical history of diabetes and cardiovascular diseases.

mcqQuestions.q: Which statement best summarizes the section about eating breakfast?
options: Breakfast is optional, but high-protein meals always guarantee weight loss.
A nutritious breakfast enhances brain function and supports overall health.
Eating pastries in the morning is more beneficial than skipping breakfast entirely.
Adolescents are the only age group that benefits from eating breakfast daily.

mcqQuestions.q: What is the central message of the "Tips for eating well" section?
options: Individuals should completely eliminate all dairy products and fats.
Processed meats and refined grains should replace natural plant foods.
Healthy eating relies on prioritizing plant foods while limiting processed items and saturated fats.
The MyPlate app is the only effective way to track daily food consumption.

mcqQuestions.q: According to the text, why are bananas considered an excellent food choice for active individuals?
options: They lower cholesterol faster than any other fruit.
They contain no fat or cholesterol and help restore carbohydrates burned during physical activity.
They contain high amounts of sodium that prevent muscle cramps.
They act as a natural toothbrush that kills mouth bacteria.

mcqQuestions.q: How were tomatoes viewed historically, according to the text?
options: They were cultivated by Spanish explorers before the Aztecs discovered them.
They were grown by the Aztecs and are closely related to deadly nightshade.
They were initially used exclusively as a medicinal herb for heart health.
They were considered a rare fruit only available in Central America.

mcqQuestions.q: Which nutrient present in dark green leafy vegetables helps promote healthy digestion?
options: Calcium
Iron
Fiber
Folate

mcqQuestions.q: What role does the MyPlate app play in dietary health?
options: It assists users in developing balanced and healthy eating habits.
It measures the exact percentage of antioxidants in meal portions.
It calculates daily calories burned during 90-minute workouts.
It replaces the need to consult medical professionals or dietitians.

mcqQuestions.q: Apples can function as an organic alternative to cleaning teeth and reducing oral bacteria.
options: TRUE
FALSE
NOT GIVEN

mcqQuestions.q: Consuming meals prepared at commercial restaurants is more detrimental to cardiovascular health than home-cooked food.
options: TRUE
FALSE
NOT GIVEN

mcqQuestions.q: Consuming high-quality protein during breakfast helps teenagers maintain sustained energy throughout the school day.
options: TRUE
FALSE
NOT GIVEN

fillInBlank: Eating a variety of foods in their natural form plays a ___vital___ role in avoiding illness and supporting health. Because takeout dishes contain excess salt and sugar, consumers should practice ___moderation___ when eating out. Dark leafy green vegetables are rich in carotenoids and act as ___antioxidants___ within the human body. Diets containing a high amount of dietary fiber are effective at helping to reduce ___cholesterol___ levels. The ___MyPlate___ application was created by the U.S. Department of Agriculture to aid users in building better eating patterns. Consuming a wholesome breakfast helps feed the brain and improves both mental focus and ___concentration___ in children. Two bananas can supply sufficient stamina for a strenuous ___90-minute___ workout. Bananas are useful after exercise because they ___replenish___ glycogen and lost bodily fluids. Although often treated as a vegetable in cooking, the tomato is actually a ___juicy nutritious___ fruit. Tomatoes are rich in antioxidants, low in fat, and contain zero ___cholesterol___.
